warnings: UNITS: the EF data has no reference-unit field, so EFs are assumed to be per kg (materials, waste), per kWh (electricity), per MJ (gas), per m3 (water), per litre (diesel) and per tonne-km (transport). Check that each matched activity really uses that unit.
A2: no per-leg linked mass in payload - using total BOM mass (3470.0 kg) on every A2 leg (total_bom_mass fallback). This likely overcounts if materials actually split across legs.
A3: annual facility totals divided by annual_production_units (50) to get per-unit inputs.
A4: no explicit finished-product mass field in payload - using sum of A1 BOM mass (3470.0 kg) as product mass.
B1/A5: the refrigerant CF is a GWP100 factor, so it is added only to the GWP100 total/fossil rows. All other rows (GWP20, GWP500, GTP, biogenic, land use, ...) exclude refrigerant emissions.
A5 crane diesel: converted 25 L -> 895 MJ (x35.8) to match the provider's reference unit. Diesel energy content is an assumption (DIESEL_MJ_PER_LITRE).
A5: commissioning_refrigerant_loss_kg has no ecoinvent provider - applying the B1 refrigerant GWP CF to GWP rows only, as an assumption.
